title: invite him over for dinner
expression: Why don't you invite him over for dinner?

sentences.en: Hey, here's an idea. Why don't you invite your new buddy over for dinner?
sentences.ko: 좋은 생각이 있어. 새 친구를 저녁에 초대하지 그러니?

sentences.en: Well, honey, um, that is what friends do.
sentences.ko: 그게, 아가, 친구끼리는 원래 그러는 거란다.

sentences.en: My mother asked me to ask you if you'd like to join us for dinner.
sentences.ko: 우리 엄마가 너한테 저녁 같이 하겠냐고 물어보라셔.
